title: Fires come alight two at a time down a hall
what: Seven pairs of unlit torches down a hall come alight one or two seconds apart after one trigger, a burning sound (462) with the first. Torches are sprites whose flame follows their state, which the campaign almost never wires.
recipe: Each torch: kDecorationTorch (30), tile 560, XSPRITE state 0 and an rx per pair. Pair k's channel is sent by a kSwitchOneWay (21) with trigger_off, wait_time 10, command 1, whose own rx is pair k-1's channel; the first is sent by a kSwitchOneWay with trigger_on. State 1 to 0 puts them out again, smoking (view.cpp:2930).
use: A procession of light to or from something. Used backwards in the Cabal's chamber: the six fires die in pairs when the priest falls.
